brief: 7 self-hosted analytics tools that beat the big SaaS dashboards.

slots.subline: Open-source dashboards built for data teams

slots.alertLine: Feature flags and A/B testing are now available in the open-source tier
slots.heroBody: Capture events, analyze funnels, and run experiments on your own infrastructure.
slots.slideSubtitle: Self-host the entire platform to keep customer data in your cloud.

slots.alertLine: On-premise deployment now supports custom report scheduling and alerts
slots.heroBody: Import Google Analytics data and own 100% of your insights with zero sampling.
slots.slideSubtitle: Compliant by default and fully customizable for enterprise analytics needs.

slots.alertLine: Plausible Analytics 2.0 ships with faster ClickHouse backend and new API
slots.heroBody: Track conversions without cookies while keeping page weight under 1 KB.
slots.slideSubtitle: A clean dashboard that respects visitor privacy and loads in milliseconds.

slots.alertLine: Umami Cloud is here, but the self-hosted version remains completely free
slots.heroBody: Spin up a modern dashboard with Prisma and Next.js on any VPS in minutes.
slots.slideSubtitle: Own your metrics without the bloat of legacy tracking platforms.

slots.alertLine: Enterprise edition adds sandboxing and advanced audit logging for self-hosted BI
slots.heroBody: Build shareable dashboards and SQL queries without writing a single line of code.
slots.slideSubtitle: Empower teams to explore data and uncover trends on their own terms.

slots.alertLine: Apache Superset 4.0 introduces advanced geospatial charts and faster caching
slots.heroBody: Connect to any SQL-speaking database and create stunning visualizations instantly.
slots.slideTitle: Visualize massive datasets at any scale
slots.slideSubtitle: A cloud-native BI platform that rivals Tableau without the licensing cost.

slots.eyebrow: the rest is up to you
slots.sublineItalic: Deploy these tools and stop renting your analytics from Silicon Valley.
